issuing_body: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota
title: United States v. Ibrahim - Preliminary Order of Forfeiture, ECF 971
supports: After Mahad Ibrahim's guilty plea to Counts 5 and 36, the court ordered forfeiture of real property at 5657 Maple Drive, Lewis Center, Ohio, and of $1,842,797.55 seized from a US Bank account held by ThinkTechAct Foundation, $456,968.36 seized from a Spire Credit Union account held by MIB Holdings LLC and $448,285.14 seized from a second Spire Credit Union account held by MIB Holdings LLC.
A money judgment forfeiture of $7,324,412 is entered against Ibrahim, with credit for the net forfeited value of each asset forfeited from him.
The order becomes final as to the defendant at sentencing.
does_not_support: It is a preliminary order; finality depends on sentencing, which this record does not show.
The money judgment is not collected cash, and the forfeited accounts are credited against it; the figures must not be summed.
It does not show the property was sold or the funds transferred to the government.
